layer_rules.CONTROL_ROOM_vs_CONTROL_PLANE: CONTROL ROOM = account/profile/settings (founder vs client). CONTROL PLANE = infrastructure. What code calls "control plane" is the design handoff bridge; it is placed in CONTROL_PLANE with disposition RECLASSIFY.
layer_rules.SITES_vs_PROJECTS: A SITE is the launched digital location (site00_sites). A PROJECT is the production record. LAUNCHED ≠ DELETED. Site capabilities sit in CLIENT_SITES; project capabilities sit in FOUNDER_PRODUCTION_WORKSPACE / CLIENT_PROJECT_ROOM.
layer_rules.MOVEMENT_LAYER: ENTER 00, WAITING ROOM (= MENU), LOCATIONS, FAST TRAVEL, SWIPE-UP and EXIT 00 are movement capabilities, not page families.
layer_rules.SHARED_PLATFORM_SERVICE: Engines that several layers consume (permissions, events, email, cost ledger). They are never owned by one surface.
